title: RiskEvent
description: Hard-risk decision record (spec sections 6, 16). Fail-closed, auditable, replayable. severity: INFO=1 WARN=2 BREACH=3; decision: ALLOW=1 REJECT=2 KILL=3. x-version 2 (v1.14, G-P0-1): every record an engine emits carries seq (1, 2, 3, ... per engine, continued across a chained restore) and prev_sha256 (lowercase hex SHA-256 of the previous record's JSONL line, 64 zeros for the first), so the audit log is a hash chain.

seq.description: Position in the engine's audit chain (1-based).

prev_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the previous record's JSONL line; 64 zeros for the first record.
